overview.description: The ProShares Short Ether ETF (SETH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long usd, short eth currency. The fund tracks the inverse (-1x) daily price movements of its underlying index. The fund aims to profit from the price decline of Ether SETH was launched on Nov 2, 2023 and is issued by ProShares.
